Life at DoorLoop

Where great people build great things

The difference every single time comes down to the people. That's why we obsess over who we hire — every person at DoorLoop makes us meaningfully better. This is the team I'm most proud of.”

Ori Tamuz, CEO & Co-Founder

Our culture

Take extreme accountability

We own the work—start to finish. We prioritize impact over ego and results over activity. If something breaks, we fix it. If something can be better, we proactively improve it. We follow through and deliver results. No excuses.

Do great things with great people

We hire thoughtfully. We invest in development and support each other across all roles, teams and time zones. We care deeply about results and about the people who help us achieve them.

Innovate relentlessly

We don’t follow the industry—we build it. As the AI leader in property management software, we break barriers and set new standards for how the industry gets work done.

Obsess over our customers

We always build with the customer in mind. We listen deeply, solve real problems and design solutions that continuously improve the lives of our customers. We win when our customers win.

Raise the bar

Excellence is our standard. We take initiative. We seek candid feedback. We push ourselves to exceed our own expectations.

Our Story

From vision to category leader

DoorLoop was founded in 2019 by five serial B2B SaaS founders including CEO Ori Tamuz, as well as David Bitton, Adam Mait, Itay Gardi, and Matthew Cave, with a simple goal: build another category-defining company. After spotting a massive gap in property management, they got to work and the market responded fast.

In just three years, DoorLoop became one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies, raising over $130M from top investors like Alpine Investors and JMI Equity and earning Forbes Best Startup Employer honors twice.

Today, we serve 10,000+ customers, helping property managers handle rent, accounting, maintenance, screening, and renewals in one modern property management software. With teams across Miami, New York, and Tel Aviv, we’re just getting started—and now is the moment to join.

Our Journey

Key milestones

2019
Founded by 5 co-founders with a vision to modernize property management. The journey begins.
2021
Product launch & $10M seed funding. Market validates our vision immediately.
2022
$20M Series A led by Alpine Investors (via ASG). Scaling momentum begins.
2024
$100M Series B led by JMI Equity & Forbes 13th Best Startup Employer.
2025
Launch of DoorLoop AI Assistant & New York City office opens.
Why DoorLoop

Why people choose DoorLoop

Property management has been overdue for change. For years, teams have been stuck with spreadsheets, busywork, and software that hasn’t kept up. If you’re ready for your next big step and want to make an impact, DoorLoop is for you.

Accelerate your career

At a company growing this fast, people who joined as individual contributors are now leading teams. We believe in giving people real ownership, and investing deeply in their growth.

Own your impact

At DoorLoop, you own meaningful work from day one. You’ll see the impact of your decisions every day, improving housing for millions and making property management simpler & more accessible.

Share in what we build

Every team member receives equity from day one. When DoorLoop wins, you share directly in the success you helped create. It’s real ownership, real upside—and a company that believes in you.

Perfect timing

Property management software is projected to reach $54B by 2032. Join DoorLoop, and you’ll grow alongside the industry, shaping its future while building your own.

The pattern

We’ve seen this before: legacy finance, HR, & project management tools evolve into modern software. Property management is at that inflection point, and DoorLoop is leading the way.

The AI shift

As the market leaders for AI in property management software, DoorLoop is reshaping how work gets done for our customers and team with world-class AI features & workflows.

DoorLoop is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, genetic information, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We use AI-assisted tools, including assessment tools that evaluate cognitive ability and personality fit, to help evaluate applications. Human oversight is maintained and no hiring decision is made solely by an automated system. For positions that can be performed in New York City, candidates may request an alternative selection process. Applicants with disabilities may also request reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process. For any of these requests please contact HR@doorloop.com.  For more information about the tools we use, bias audit results, and how we collect and protect applicant personal data, please review our Applicant Privacy Notice.

FAQS

Common questions

What are DoorLoop's salary ranges?

Salaries are competitive and will be based on the specific role for which you are applying. We're looking for top talent and offer competitive, market-based compensation. Feel free to apply, and we'd be happy to share more details with you.

Does DoorLoop offer equity compensation?

Yes, every team member receives equity through our ownership plans, regardless of role or location. We believe that everyone at DoorLoop should benefit from the company's success.

Where are DoorLoop's offices?

DoorLoop has three offices, located in Miami Beach (US), New York (US) and Tel Aviv (Israel).

What does the interview process look like?

Our Talent Acquisition team will review your application in detail. If your experience and qualifications match what we're looking for, a member of our Talent Acquisition team will reach out to you by email to move forward.

Does DoorLoop offer remote or hybrid work?

Work arrangements vary by role and department. Most positions have hybrid options, and we typically ask team members to come into the office most of the week to enable collaboration and communication. We're happy to discuss options based on the role and your preferences.

Why is DoorLoop well-positioned for the AI era?

We've built AI-native from the ground up. Our AI Assistant handles up to 80% of tenant requests automatically, freeing up property managers to focus on strategic work. We've also partnered with Stripe to process billions in payments. We're at the intersection of AI and a massive, underserved market — the perfect position to define the next decade.

Ready to build something extraordinary?

Join a team that's transforming property management for millions of people. Your next chapter starts here.
